# Shift handover: personal-assistant chats (ending on Crinklewitch card game) · 2026-11-11 22:05
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. There is no code or project file here: the "work" is a series of chat sessions (dated 2023-05-20 → 2023-05-30) about many personal topics. Read this file in full before answering.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (mode `quick`, no exam was run)

## 0 · Read these first
There are no project files. The repo holds only the initial commit (`1341236 start`) and `.claude/` [verified: git status / git log]. This handover is the only source.

## 1 · Status
🟡 There is no open technical work. The last thread (Crinklewitch elevator pitch) is unfinished: the user said "Can you try again?" and got a fourth pitch, but never said they were happy with it. Several earlier answers I gave contain likely factual errors (see §9). Don't repeat them.

## 2 · Picture
Topics in chat order: Dall-E prompt → BJJ training summary → movies/Marvel/soundtracks → Beyoncé activism → laptop + Incase sleeve → podcasts/history books → Barcelona itinerary → confidence/relationships → markdown+Unsplash image instruction → closet/boots/Coach bag/hair care → photography/drones → **Crinklewitch** (the user's witch-themed card game; bonus-card names, expansions, pitches). The most recent and most likely topic to come back is Crinklewitch.

**Crinklewitch facts** [user said unless tagged]:
- Name: **Crinklewitch** (said 2023-05-30). Player count is **2–8** (the user corrected my "2–6"). The user says "we", so they design it with someone else.
- Mechanics from my earlier pitches [assumed, set in an earlier chat I can't see]: witch theme, players race to collect **three Winner Tokens**, **Rule Cards** change how the game plays (some silly), **Bonus Cards** give advantages. My second pitch said Winner Tokens can be "used to cast spells"; this is unconfirmed and may be wrong.
- The user liked pitch 1 (the "unleash your inner witch… three Winner Tokens… Bonus Cards… friends or family… wickedly good time" one) and pitch 2 (the "fast-paced, easy to learn, rule cards keep each round fresh, whimsical illustrations, ultimate Crinklewitch champion" one). They asked for a combination at 2–8 players. Pitch 3 (short, "cackling with delight… magical night in") got "Can you try again?". Pitch 4 was my last message ("hilarious witch-themed card game that will cast a spell on you… perfect for 2-8 players who love a good laugh"), with no reaction yet.

## 3 · Next actions
1. If Crinklewitch comes up: write a combined pitch that keeps pitch 1's energy and pitch 2's specifics (easy to learn, fresh rounds, whimsical art, champion line), says 2–8 players, and does not state the unconfirmed "tokens cast spells" mechanic. · done when the user approves a pitch.
2. Otherwise, answer whatever the user brings, using the personal context in §5.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Don't | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Say "2–6 players" for Crinklewitch | The user corrected it to 2–8 | The user changes it |
| Reuse Bonus Card names with conflicting effects | My lists already contain duplicates: "Magic Amulet" (swap with discard pile / block a Rule Card) and "Crystal Ball" (reorder the top 3 / take a card from a hand) | The user picks one version |
| Say "Incipio Icon Sleeve" | The product the user means is the **Incase** Icon Sleeve. I mixed the brands up | — |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** [user said; dates are when they said it]:
- Trains **Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu**: a white-to-blue-belt program, home drills (2023-05-20).
- Watches *Hawkeye* on Disney+ **with their sister** and had finished episode 5 (2023-05-20). Planned to watch *Spider-Man: No Way Home* "next weekend", which is about 2023-05-27/28, after re-watching the Raimi *Spider-Man* trilogy. Added *The Falcon and the Winter Soldier* and *Loki* to their watchlist. Interested in the Marvel One-Shots.
- Has a **Spotify playlist of movie soundtracks** (loves Hans Zimmer), adds tracks weekly, and uses it to focus while working on projects.
- Laptop battery drains on resource-intensive projects. Considering an upgrade to an unnamed brand "known for performance and battery life". Has a **13-inch laptop**. Their current bag is worn, and they're considering the **Incase Icon Sleeve**, which should fit a charger and a notebook (2023-05-25).
- Listens to **true crime and self-improvement podcasts on a ~40-minute commute each way**. Wants to branch out and chose history. Interested in *Guns, Germs, and Steel* (2023-05-26).
- Asked for a 4-day **Barcelona** itinerary focused on food and culture (2023-05-27).
- **Self-conscious around new people.** Plans to **attend social events and join a public speaking group** (2023-05-27).
- Closet: will start with the **Closet app**. Bought **black ankle boots from Zara around 2023-05-07** ("three weeks ago" on 05-28) and had worn them 3 times. Asked how to *stretch* them. Considering a **Coach handbag**. Hair is **wavy, dry in places, frizz-prone**. Loves a **Moroccan oil serum from their stylist**. Considering the **L'Oréal Paris EverPure Repair & Protect Mask once a week** (2023-05-28).
- Curious about **drone photography** (2023-05-29).
- Designs the card game **Crinklewitch** with others (2023-05-30).

| I assumed / did | User wanted | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wrote "2–6 players" | 2–8 | Use 2–8 everywhere | "we want the game to be 2-8 players" |
| Gave separate pitches | One combined pitch | Merge the liked parts and don't start from scratch | "make another one that combines those ideas" |

Note: source.unsplash.com has been shut down [assumed], so say so if it fails | "use markdown, and do not use backslash, do not use code blocks. Please use unsplash API" (2023-05-27) |
| — | Hard limits | Respect stated limits exactly. My Akira Dall-E prompt was **419 chars, over the 400 limit** [verified: python len → 419] | "keeping it to 400 characters" |
| — | Edit lists in place | When the user edits a list, return the whole updated list, applying exactly what they asked | BJJ list edits |

## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- **Dall-E prompt** (final): dystopian London sunset, Thames full of debris, broken London Eye, crumbling skyscrapers, Akira style. 419 chars, so it needs trimming if reused.
- **BJJ summary** (final state): (1) White→blue program, Weeks 1–20, as follows: 1 Guard, 2 Side control, 3 Closed guard, 4 Half guard, 5 Knee-on-belly, 6 Mount, 7 Mount (duplicate), 8 Back control, 9 Takedowns, 10 Passes, 11 Submissions, 12 Transitions, 13 Drilling, 14 Sparring, 15 Conditioning, 16 Mount, 17 Back control, 18 Takedowns, 19 Passes, 20 Submissions. The "Additional weeks:" header was removed. (2) Four-week program (old #2 and #3 combined): W1 Fundamentals of submissions + top 5: armbar, triangle choke, rear-naked choke, guillotine, kimura · W2 Gi grips and control · W3 Kimura attacks and defenses · W4 Theory and visualization. (3) Home drills: shrimping, knee cutters, bridge and roll, guard retention, plus the warm-ups dynamic stretching, jumping jacks, lunges. My last reply was **cut off** mid-#3, so resend the full list if asked.
- **Podcast schedule**: Mon–Tue Hardcore History, Wed–Thu Lore, Fri The Dollop.
- **Barcelona itinerary**: 4 days. Day 1: Sagrada Família, Gothic Quarter, Park Güell. Day 2: Picasso Museum, Cal Pep, La Rambla, Casa Mono. Day 3: churros, La Boqueria, Palau de la Música, Can Majó, Casa Batlló. Day 4: Granja Viader, Fundació Miró, El Quim de la Boqueria, Cathedral, dinner at El Celler de Can Roca. The user pasted it back and I approved it.
- **Group-finding sources**: Meetup, Toastmasters, community centre/library, Facebook/LinkedIn groups, Eventbrite.
- **Crinklewitch Bonus Card names**: three spell lists, familiars (Cat's Eye, Owl's Wisdom, Crow's Eyes, Spider's Web…), trinkets (Lucky Charm, Crystal Ball, Golden Key, Cursed Coin…). **Expansion ideas**: new card types, new Rule Cards, new themes, solo, co-op, team/elimination modes.

## 9 · Gotchas: my earlier answers that are probably wrong [assumed; correct them if the topic returns]
- The pasted "gramby roll" text: the move is the **Granby roll**. It is not named after Marcelo Garcia.
- Marvel: *Winter Soldier* has no time travel. *Quantumania* had already been released (Feb 2023), not "rumored". The Raimi trilogy did not introduce Spider-Verse parallel universes.
- Incase Icon Sleeve: the details I gave ("DuraFlex", IPX2, dimensions, 4 colours, 2-year warranty, hardshell) were not checked and are probably invented.
- Podcast episode titles and numbers I listed are largely invented. Check them before citing.
- *Guns, Germs, and Steel*: Diamond is a geographer/physiologist, not a historian. "Lucky latitudes" is not his term: his argument is the **east–west axis** of Eurasia. The Anna Karenina principle in the book is about domesticable animals.
- Barcelona: **El Celler de Can Roca is in Girona**, about 1 h away. "Café de Oriente" and "La Barca del Salamanca" are doubtful.
- Beyoncé: dates and claims are shaky, e.g. the Formation Scholarship was 2018 and the Ivy Park labour story was 2016.

question: Can you suggest some activities I can do during my commute to work?
gold: The user would prefer suggestions related to listening to new podcasts or audiobooks, especially the genre beyond true crime or self-improvement, such as history. They may not be interested in activities that require visual attention, such as reading or watching videos, as they are commuting. The user would not prefer general podcast topics such as true crime or self-improvement, as the user wants to explore other topics.
answer:
Here are some ideas for your 40-minute commute each way, based on what you already listen to and what you're working on:

**Keep the podcasts going**
- **History:** You wanted to branch out from true crime and self-improvement, so try the schedule we made: *Hardcore History* on Monday and Tuesday, *Lore* on Wednesday and Thursday, and *The Dollop* on Friday.
- **Audiobook:** *Guns, Germs, and Steel* would take a few weeks of commutes, and it suits a regular routine.

**Music**
- Play your movie soundtrack playlist. Hans Zimmer can help you get into focus mode before work or wind down after it.
- Use the commute to find new tracks to add each week.

**Things that support your goals**
- **BJJ:** Mentally go over the moves you're drilling this week, like submissions, guard retention and transitions. Visualization is part of your four-week program, so the commute counts as training.
- **Public speaking:** Practise short talks or introductions out loud if you're driving, or in your head on transit. It's low-pressure prep for the speaking group and social events.
- **Learn some Spanish or Catalan:** Try an app or a language podcast to get ready for your Barcelona trip.

**Creative time**
- **Crinklewitch:** Write down new Bonus Card or Rule Card ideas, expansion ideas, or work on the pitch.
- **Photography:** Watch drone photography tutorials, or read up on camera settings and drone rules.

**If you take public transit**
- Read a physical book or e-book, journal, or plan your outfits in the Closet app.
- Try a short guided meditation or breathing exercise to start the day calmly.

If you're driving, stick to the audio options and use voice memos to capture ideas hands-free.

Do you drive or take transit? I can tailor the list to whichever it is.
